changes.description: Generic coset, tree, HNN, orbit, cyclic-presentation and module arguments are in the common paper; all local source adapters, corrections and concrete examples are in the N005 application. Title/abstract/bibliography/scope repetition is consolidated.

Repeated proofs of flag-transitivity versus coset Helly and Borel-preserving residue generation are replaced by actual internal references to complete common Lemmas 1 and 4. No trivial-Borel hypothesis is introduced.

Its use of distinguished involutions is made explicit by referring to faithful regular inputs of O-thm:twist. The separate invariant indexed quotient action remains valid without a geometric conclusion. This clarifies the existing proof, not a general nonregular quotient theorem.

The properly labelled graph and alternating-word presentation are restated before the separation proof; odd pair labels require equal vertex orders. No parabolic-embedding or faithful whole-group claim is added.

Local labels are namespaced; H1–H6 distinguish the nonfirm example equations; exact common-paper references replace obsolete separate-note references. N006 Proposition 5.1 is explicitly attributed as N006. Definitions of empty intersections, left cosets, finite types and indexed actions remain visible.

All three unchanged whole programs are printed with wrapped lines. No source line is removed. A compact ordered-text check ignores only whitespace and exact page-number footers and rejects deletion of a required token.

changes.description: All prior freezes remain immutable. The two local migration scripts were one-time author aids and are not a regenerating source of the final TeX; they are deliberately outside the export manifest. The first-class TeX and portable check.py are authoritative.
